ayahs.text: قٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
ayahs.translation: Qaf. By the Glorious Qur'an

ayahs.text: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing

ayahs.text: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return

ayahs.text: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
ayahs.translation: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book

ayahs.text: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.translation: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case

ayahs.text: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
ayahs.translation: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein

ayahs.text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
ayahs.translation: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon

ayahs.text: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.translation: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave

ayahs.text: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
ayahs.translation: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops

ayahs.text: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters

ayahs.text: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
ayahs.translation: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead

ayahs.text: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.translation: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud

ayahs.text: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
ayahs.translation: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot

ayahs.text: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.translation: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect

ayahs.text: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
ayahs.translation: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
ayahs.translation: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein

ayahs.text: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left

ayahs.text: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.translation: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun

ayahs.text: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.translation: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day

ayahs.text: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness

ayahs.text: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day

ayahs.text: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony)

ayahs.text: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
ayahs.translation: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate

ayahs.text: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.translation: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter

ayahs.text: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.translation: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom

ayahs.text: قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.translation: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error

ayahs.text: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.translation: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning

ayahs.text: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
ayahs.translation: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
ayahs.translation: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come

ayahs.text: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.translation: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant

ayahs.text: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
ayahs.translation: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one

ayahs.text: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.translation: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart

ayahs.text: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
ayahs.translation: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality

ayahs.text: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us

ayahs.text: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.translation: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)

ayahs.text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.translation: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence

ayahs.text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
ayahs.translation: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us

ayahs.text: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
ayahs.translation: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun

ayahs.text: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.translation: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations

ayahs.text: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
ayahs.translation: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
ayahs.translation: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves)

ayahs.text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.translation: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
ayahs.translation: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make)

ayahs.text: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.translation: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat
